name: siemens/continuous-clearing
description: The Continuous Clearing Tool scans and collects third-party open-source components used in projects based on NPM, NuGet, Debian, Maven, Python, Conan, Alpine, and Cargo. It then uploads the collected data to SW360 and FOSSology for license clearing, using the respective project ID provided.
